data.body: Defect (investigated 2026-10-09, not fixed): Triage Router condition misrouted a SIMPLE classification to the tool branch. Chat chat.ba470e6a1d3ebc8c2aa7172503db9309cf5b5c75, workflow.custom.6 v5. classify.1 (model_call) returned "\n\nSIMPLE"; route.1 predicate {kind:eq,path:value,value:"SIMPLE"} is exact equality, so the whitespace made it false -> gate.1 approval -> deep.1 "Grounded answer" (26 tools) -> web_search; quick.1 "Direct answer" (toolIds []) skipped "branch not taken". Code facts: graph_pass/model_call.rs returns Ok(Value::String(text)) untrimmed for a non-plan model_call, while the agent path trims assistant_text in model_tool_loop.rs; evaluate_predicate eq/neq has no trim or case fold. Only triggers when tier:simple resolves to a model that prefixes its answer (here Sparky qwen3.8-flash-next); the same workflow on deepseek-flash returned bare SIMPLE and routed correctly. Fix options: trim the model_call node value, or normalise scalar strings in eq/neq.
